description:
Consolidates the workspace-wide propagation work surfaced by JMAP-510h's review pass:

- JMAP-510h.44 — FileNodeBackend trait doc lacks an auth-contract block (principal_id / shareWith semantics). Mail-server's trait doc has nothing equivalent either.
- JMAP-510h.40 — handle_filenode_* public fns have one-sentence doc, no contract (arg shape, JmapError variants, return-envelope shape, permission-check ownership). Mail-server's handle_email_* is the same.
- JMAP-510h.39 — top-level pub use re-exports of upstream jmap-server types lock jmap-server's major version into this crate's public surface. Includes types that no external consumer needs (AddedItem, ClosureHandler, FileNodeProperty). Mail-server has the same shape.

Per workspace AGENTS.md 'Canonical Templates' rule, these are canonical-first fixes:

1. Add to canonical jmap-mail-server:
   - MailBackend trait header doc block: principal_id seam citation, per-method enforcement (create/update/destroy authorization against shareWith / myRights), handler-does-no-authz contract, jmap-sharing-server relationship.
   - handle_email_* (8 handlers) docstring contract: arg shape pointer to RFC 8621 §X.Y, possible JmapError variants, return envelope, permission-check ownership.
   - Audit top-level re-exports: keep what consumers of MailBackend actually need (trait bounds, error types). Move ClosureHandler / AddedItem / etc. behind #[doc(hidden)] or into a sub-module. Decide whether re-exports go to lib root or to a namespaced sub-module.

2. Propagate the same shape to the 6 extension-server siblings: chat, calendars, tasks, contacts, filenode, sharing, metadata. Same trait header block, same handler doc contract template, same re-export audit per crate.

3. Each sibling has the same three children:
   .1 = trait doc auth-contract block
   .2 = handler docstring contracts
   .3 = re-export audit + sub-module reorganization

Decomposition would produce 1 canonical + 7 siblings × 3 children = ~22 child beads. Workspace-coordinated change, P2.

Cross-references:
- JMAP-510h.44 (filenode trait doc)
- JMAP-510h.40 (filenode handler docs)
- JMAP-510h.39 (filenode re-exports)

These three beads remain open under the JMAP-510h review epic and would close once their respective filenode-server children land under this propagation epic.
title: Workspace propagation epic: extension-server trait + handler + re-export contract sweep
